ImageUploadInput.description: A custom SimpleForm input for rendering the image upload Dropzone UI. It generates the necessary HTML structure, including hidden fields for upload state and `data` attributes for frontend JavaScript configuration.

interactions.interaction_0: Renders HTML for the image upload `Dropzone` and associated hidden fields (`upload_id`, `uri`, `deletion`).
interactions.interaction_2: Utilizes `FileUpload` to generate S3 presigned post parameters.

techDebt: Uses both `_upload_id` and `_uri` suffixes for hidden fields for backward compatibility, which could be simplified if `_uri` was consistently used as the primary identifier. [Source: app/inputs/image_upload_input.rb]

class UploadInput < SimpleForm::Inputs::Base
  enable :label, :errors, :hint, :required, :placeholder

  def input(opts = {})
    template.capture do
      template.tag.div(class: 'xui-upload', data:) do
        template.concat @builder.hidden_field(field_name, opts.merge({value: value.id, id: nil}))
        template.concat dropzone
        template.concat input_options.delete(:extra_html) if input_options.key? :extra_html
      end
    end
  end

def dropzone
    template.tag.div(class: 'xui-upload-zone xui-upload-target') do
      template.tag.div(dropzone_placeholder, class: 'dz-message')
    end
  end

S3FileDeletionJob.description: An asynchronous job responsible for deleting files from S3. It uses the `xikolo-s3` gem to interact with S3 and includes robust error handling.

interactions.interaction_0: Receives an S3 URI as an argument. [Source: app/jobs/s3_file_deletion_job.rb]
interactions.interaction_1: Calls `Xikolo::S3.object(uri).delete` to remove the file from S3. [Source: app/jobs/s3_file_deletion_job.rb]
interactions.interaction_2: Reports errors to Mnemosyne and Sentry. [Source: app/jobs/s3_file_deletion_job.rb]

codeBlocks.code: class S3FileDeletionJob < ApplicationJob   queue_as :default   queue_with_priority :eventual    def perform(uri)     Xikolo::S3.object(uri).delete if uri.present?   rescue URI::InvalidURIError, ArgumentError     # No valid URI, no deletion   rescue Aws::S3::Errors::ServiceError => e     ::Mnemosyne.attach_error(e)     ::Sentry.capture_exception(e)   end end

Xikolo::S3.description: A helper gem that provides common S3 file operations, client instantiation, and configuration. It defines principles around file handling, including metadata fields like `xikolo-state` and `xikolo-purpose` for upload validation and processing.

interactions.interaction_0: Provides `bucket_for(:uploads)` method used by `FileUpload` to get an S3 bucket instance.
interactions.interaction_1: Defines the `xikolo-purpose` and `xikolo-state` metadata fields, which are set by `FileUpload` during presigning and used by backend services for validation. [Source: gems/xikolo-s3/README.md]
interactions.interaction_2: Mentions `SingleFileUpload` (upload by ID) and `UploadByUri` as upload contracts, guiding how services should interact with uploaded files. [Source: gems/xikolo-s3/README.md]

FileUpload.description: Generates presigned URLs and fields for direct file uploads to S3. It encapsulates the logic for configuring S3 upload parameters, including purpose, content type, size, and image dimensions, and adds necessary metadata.

interactions.interaction_0: Initialized by `ImageUploadInput` and `UploadInput` with upload-specific parameters.
interactions.interaction_1: Interacts with `Xikolo::S3.bucket_for(:uploads)` to obtain an S3 bucket instance.
interactions.interaction_2: Generates an `Aws::S3::PresignedPost` with configured `key_starts_with`, `acl`, `signature_expiration`, and metadata (`xikolo-purpose`, `xikolo-state`, `image-target-height/width`).
interactions.interaction_3: Provides `url` and `fields` methods for frontend consumption.
interactions.interaction_4: Maps MIME types to file extensions for validation via `extension_filter`.

techDebt: The current implementation aligns with the 'Upload by id (SingleFileUpload)' approach described in `xikolo-s3` documentation, which is noted to have 'drawbacks' and `UploadByUri` is preferred for new implementations. This indicates a potential for future refactoring or migration. [Source: lib/file_upload.rb, gems/xikolo-s3/README.md]

Dropzone.js.description: A client-side JavaScript library used for handling drag-and-drop file uploads, displaying file previews, and managing upload progress. It is the foundational UI component for all file upload features.

interactions.interaction_0: Initialized by `image-upload.js`, `mdupload.js`, and `upload.js` to attach file upload behavior to HTML elements.
interactions.interaction_1: Sends files directly to S3 using presigned URLs and fields provided by the backend.

mdupload.js.description: Attaches Dropzone.js behavior for file uploads within markdown editors. It dispatches events to the editor to insert links to uploaded files.

interactions.interaction_1: Reads S3 configuration from HTML `data` attributes.
interactions.interaction_2: On successful upload, dispatches a `markdownEditor::addLink` custom event to the markdown editor widget, providing an internal URI for the uploaded file.
interactions.interaction_3: For older markdown editors, updates `textArea.xiUrlMapping` with internal to external URL mappings.

techDebt: Does not explicitly handle file deletion from S3 on `removedfile` event, implying reliance on backend `TextWithUploadsProcessor` for cleanup. This could lead to orphaned files if the backend process fails or is not correctly implemented for all scenarios. [Source: app/assets/util/forms/mdupload.js, gems/xikolo-s3/README.md]
